name: tsnl-calm
about: TSNL teaching shorts. From the TSNL brand pack: no cut zooms, one slow push, calm fades, gold on warm white, 1 s hold then 1 s fade, never tighter than mid-torso, main cut under 90 s.

style.push: one slow push, at most 0.25 %/s and +6 %
style.broll: covers every jump cut; own Higgsfield clips first, then Storyblocks; no AI b-roll on Shorts
style.music: Epidemic Sound bed 18 to 22 dB under the voice
style.hook: hook in the first 1.5 s; no generic sky in the hook
